observations.body: A woman pours costly ointment on Jesus at Bethany; Jesus interprets it toward burial, and Judas then agrees with the priests to deliver him for silver.

payload.posture: Read Matthew 26:6–16 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a woman pours costly ointment on Jesus at Bethany; Jesus interprets it toward burial, and Judas then agrees with the priests to deliver him for silver. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
